review.material: Bibliographic identity corroborated by the author’s publication list and the publisher-deposited record already held in the catalogue.
review.limitations: No original text or substantive official abstract was retrieved. The generic title is insufficient for a content summary.

sections.title: What is identified
sections.text: A six-page contribution titled Shape Grammars appears in the journal’s 1998 anniversary issue, pp. 86–91.

sections.title: What is still unavailable
sections.text: Its detailed purpose, claims, method and conclusion were not verified. Descriptions of other Knight papers should not be used to fill these gaps.

sections.title: How to continue
sections.text: Follow the publisher record for the original. This item differs from the 1998 chapter Designing a Shape Grammar and from the 1999 classification papers.
